theorems.name: Submission.rsod_blowUpMap_measure_scaling
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (x : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ B : Set (Amb n ℓ), ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' B) = (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) B ∧ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict B).map (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r) = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) • (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' B)
